$comment: Machine-readable index of every foreign figure this project may cite (§2.3, §29; C-029, C-040). NOT the source of truth — §29 of docs/Evolutionsarchitektur V1 zu V2.md is, and this file must never contradict it. It exists so the two gate conditions can be checked by a program instead of by memory: no figure without an evidence class, and no shared ranking across measurements whose reader, judge, top-k or context budget differ or are unknown.
$comment_null: null means the SOURCE does not state it. That is a finding, not a gap in this file — a value must never be estimated, inferred, or carried over from another source (§29.1).
